about: Party stands (tick thief): 'dungeon clear regroup combat' (rel 29, above reach spell 20 and the whole rotation) armed on an empty stock attackers list and returned true on every path, so a combat-flagged ranged DPS with no threat landed never cast (issue #18). A split Shattered Halls formation with a Darkcaster and a Sharpshooter 38yd apart (snapshot tr-20260922-185222-7#4) is forced through the Advanced LOS drag, so casters park and followers sit at camp flagged before their own threat lands. Fixed on master by 5bace3da (a live, valid, in-LOS target counts as contribution; the action yields when it issues no move). Start is moved 25yd up the corridor from the real tank spot.
